Options:
  -b, --fqbn FQBN  Select the board identifier
  --board-options OPTIONS  Set board options
  --build-path DIRECTORY  Set intermediate build directory
  --output-dir DIRECTORY  Set binary output directory
  --build-property PROPERTY  Override a build property
  --libraries DIRECTORY  Add a library search directory
  --warnings LEVEL  Set compiler warning level
  --clean  Discard previous build files
  --export-binaries  Copy binaries into the sketch directory
  -j, --jobs JOBS  Set concurrent jobs
  -v, --verbose  Increase output detail
  --only-compilation-database  Generate compile_commands.json
